corrections.finding: The PDF page 4 equation (1.14) contains σ_- A_* before the coefficient ratio; the prior review omitted σ_- when deriving b.

evidence.locator: PDF p.4, Corollary 1.3, equation (1.14), lower third of page

corrections.reason: σ_-=√(2·2/1)=2, μRγ+α(γ−1)^2=3·1·2+2=8. Therefore C_*=3/4 and midpoint a=C_*/4=3/16. A_*=2·3·2/(2·1²·2)=3. Formula (1.14) gives b=σ_-A_*·6/8=2·3·6/8=9/2. Formula W=6Fz(1−z) gives J/F²=12. Thus option A is exact; option D omits σ_- in b.
corrections.impact: Original blind review is preserved as an audit trail and should be superseded for XM01 only.

wordingNotes.finding: The mathematically precise statement is that the disk center is 1+iφ with |φ−t|=O((log T)^(1/200)); replacing “圆心接近t” by “圆心高度接近t” resolves the shorthand without changing the answer.
